exposure: Placental lesions (maternal vascular malperfusion, fetal vascular malperfusion, maternal inflammatory responses, fetal inflammatory responses, villitis of unknown etiology)
outcome: Composite neonatal outcome (neonatal sepsis, blood transfusion, phototherapy, respiratory morbidity, cerebral morbidity, necrotizing enterocolitis, or death)
cohort: The study included neonates with a birth-weight <= 10th percentile, born between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation, during 2010-2018.
finding: Male gender, fetal inflammatory response (FIR), and villitis of unknown etiology (VUE) are independently associated with adverse composite neonatal outcome in small for gestational age (SGA) neonates.
